title: A Codex child's `Get-ChildItem Env:` fails with a duplicate-key error, so its environment likely holds two names differing only in case
outcome: A delegated session's environment on Windows has no case-variant duplicate names, so ordinary PowerShell environment reads work.
acceptance: The cause is classified with evidence: which names were duplicated and which layer introduced them (TermAl's child environment assembly, the Codex runtime, or the user environment).
If TermAl introduced them, a delegated child on Windows receives an environment with no names differing only in case, and a test covers the assembly.
